subject.title: fix(message): ignore populated location on text sends

question: Should Telegram-specific model-input normalization live in the Telegram plugin through a generic core seam, or should core intentionally own this Telegram-only pre-dispatch policy?
rationale: The PR fixes a real delivery failure, but choosing between a plugin-owned extension point and a core special case defines the durable channel/plugin architecture and cannot be resolved safely by automated repair.

options.title: Use a plugin-owned seam
options.body: Add or use a generic, maintainer-approved pre-dispatch capability so Telegram owns its location normalization and core remains channel-agnostic.

options.title: Approve the core exception
options.body: Accept this Telegram-only core normalizer as a documented exception and retain tests proving local and Gateway parity.

recommendation.title: Use a plugin-owned seam
recommendation.body: Add or use a generic, maintainer-approved pre-dispatch capability so Telegram owns its location normalization and core remains channel-agnostic.

likelyOwner.reason: A current Telegram/plugin-runtime owner should decide the long-term owner boundary before this public action contract lands.
